text: Wouldn’t recommend. If you’re looking for a non slide rug don’t buy these. They slide really bad. Very cute but they do slide. Guess I’m going to have to keep looking. Every rug I like say will not slide but get them and they do😡

product_metadata.title: LINLA Non-Slip Soft Microfibers Chenille Bathroom Rug Mat, Machine Washable and Absorbent Fast Dry Kitchen Rugs,Thick Modern Plush Carpet for Tub,Shower and Door (16x24 inches, Black)
features: Ultra Comfortable - 100% premium Chenille.The fibers are very dense, which makes it very soft. At the same time, it is warm enough to prevent your feet from coming into direct contact with cold tiles or floors after a shower, and it also relaxes tired and stressed feet.

Superior Absorbency - Dense chenille fibers can quickly lock in moisture，the feet is able to dry quickly and cleanly after you step out of the shower, making your bathroom clean and tidy. To ensure comfort during use, the mat can be cleaned and dried when it is saturated with water absorption.

Non-Slip Backing - Cleverly bottom non-slip design. No shifting and skidding. Due to its waterproof craftsmanship, there's no need to worry about water on the blanket penetrating to the floor below. Tips: Please put the mat on the clean dry smooth bathroom floor. Keep bottom of mat dry to maximize the anti-skid effect of the mat.

Easy Care - You would better shake off the dust before washing, as this will make it easier to clean. Moreover, we recommend that you clean your mats regularly in cold water, separate for different colors.No matter how many times it is washed and dried, the color will not fade and there is no need to worry about damage to the mat. Durable for a long-time use.

Multipurpose - Our products are available in a variety of colors, is a great decorative piece. Perfect for nearly any space in your house, works in tub, shower, living room, bedroom, door or any other place where you need feet support and warmth. Great gift ideas for all occasions, Christmas, Valentine's Day and so on.
